_comment: What the gate SHOULD say about a render, by pattern slug — the orchestrator's ground truth, kept by hand. Keys beginning with _ are ignored. Values: keep | kill | repair. Used by scripts/xs-gate-replay.ts to score a rubric change against real renders instead of against an argument. Rows fall into three groups: gems that shipped (keep), culls the orchestrator judged shippable (keep — these are the over-culls), and the false keeps Rebecca later unpublished (kill — these are what a looser rubric must NOT let back in).
